queries:
WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.death_country,
           AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won
    FROM player_award_vote AS v
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id
    WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       avg_points_won,
       ABS(avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM country_averages)) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages

SELECT
    p.birth_country,
    AVG(h.votes) - (SELECT AVG(votes) FROM hall_of_fame) AS vote_difference
FROM hall_of_fame AS h
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
GROUP BY p.birth_country

WITH country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.birth_country, AVG(h.votes) AS country_average
    FROM hall_of_fame AS h
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(votes) AS overall_average
    FROM hall_of_fame
)
SELECT
    c.birth_country,
    c.country_average,
    o.overall_average,
    o.overall_average - c.country_average AS difference
FROM country_averages AS c
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o

WITH player_averages AS (
    SELECT player_id, AVG(points_won) AS avg_points
    FROM player_award_vote
    GROUP BY player_id
),
country_averages AS (
    SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pa.avg_points) AS avg_points
    FROM player_averages AS pa
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_country
)
SELECT death_country,
       ABS(avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM country_averages)) AS absolute_difference
FROM country_averages;

SELECT death_country, AVG(height) AS average_height
FROM player
GROUP BY death_country
